--cache-type-v

name: -lm
--load-mode
options.description: Model loading mode (default: auto) - auto: mmap, unless a device does not support it - none: no special loading mode - mmap: memory-map model (if mmap disabled, slower load but may reduce pageouts if not using mlock) - mlock: force system to keep model in RAM rather than swapping or compressing - mmap+mlock: mmap + force system to keep model in RAM rather than swapping or compressing - dio: use DirectIO if available

name: -lzm
--lazy-mode
options.description: On-demand reading of certain tensors, for example per-layer embeddings (default: auto) - on: read the rows of such tensors from disk on demand instead of keeping them resident (requires mmap) - auto: on, but only for tensors larger than 4 GiB - off: always keep them resident

options.name: --numa
options.description: Attempt optimizations that help on some NUMA systems - distribute: spread execution evenly over all nodes - isolate: only spawn threads on CPUs on the node that execution started on - numactl: use the CPU map provided by numactl if run without this previously, it is recommended to drop the system page cache before using this see https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/issues/1437

name: -dev
--device
options.description: Comma-separated list of devices to use for offloading (none = don't offload) use --list-devices to see a list of available devices

options.name: --list-devices
options.description: Print list of available devices and exit

name: -ot
--override-tensor
options.description: Override tensor buffer type

name: -cmoe
--cpu-moe
options.description: Keep all Mixture of Experts (MoE) weights in the CPU

name: -ncmoe
--n-cpu-moe
options.description: Keep the Mixture of Experts (MoE) weights of the first N layers in the CPU

--n-cpu-ffn
options.description: Keep the dense FFN weights of the first N layers in the CPU (dense models

name: -ngl
--gpu-layers

options.description: Max. number of layers to store in VRAM, either an exact number, 'auto', or 'all' (default: auto)

name: -sm
--split-mode
options.description: How to split the model across multiple GPUs, one of: - none: use one GPU only - layer (default): split layers and KV across GPUs (pipelined) - row: split weight across GPUs by rows (parallelized) - tensor: split weights and KV across GPUs (parallelized, EXPERIMENTAL)

name: -ts
--tensor-split
options.description: Fraction of the model to offload to each GPU, comma-separated list of proportions, e.g. 3,1

name: -mg
--main-gpu
options.description: The GPU to use for the model (with split-mode = none), or for intermediate results and KV (with split-mode = row) (default: 0)

options.description: Whether to adjust unset arguments to fit in device memory ('on' or 'off', default: 'on')

name: -fitt
--fit-target
options.description: Target margin per device for --fit, comma-separated list of values, single value is broadcast across all devices, default: 1024

name: -fitc
--fit-ctx
